heuristics.name: common-headword-target
heuristics.description: Pick the option that is the standard plain gloss of a typical hard ISEE headword (e.g. tarry->linger, upbraid->scold, sporadic->intermittent); i.e. the option most easily imagined as the definition of a test-worthy word

heuristics.name: odd-register / pure guess
heuristics.description: No option stood out as a likelier gloss; picked the somewhat more distinctive or less everyday word

notes: Synonym options are all ordinary words in the same part of speech with no shared axis; I found no structural signal. Every pick is a guess; no option could be ruled out with certainty.
